description: Ministry of Industry & Commerce - Notify that 'Sri Lanka Society of Physiotherapy' authorize for the purpose of society
reasoning: This gazette notification exercises powers under the Societies Ordinance (Chapter 123) to authorize a society's purpose and grant a specific exemption from a section of that Ordinance. The content is primarily about applying and modifying legal/regulatory provisions, specifically exempting an organization from certain statutory requirements. This fits the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which cover "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" and "legal notices and statutory declarations." While a minister is named, this is in the context of executing legal authority rather than detailing personal appointments or portfolio responsibilities.
